ayahs.en: By the sky and the night comer
ayahs.e2: By the heaven and the nightly star

ayahs.en: And what can make you know what is the night comer
ayahs.e2: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is
˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness

ayahs.ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظࣱ‏
ayahs.en: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector
ayahs.e2: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺

ayahs.en: So let man observe from what he was created
ayahs.e2: Let people then consider what they were created from

ayahs.en: He was created from a fluid, ejected
ayahs.e2: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid

ayahs.en: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs
ayahs.e2: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage

ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able
ayahs.e2: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺

ayahs.en: The Day when secrets will be put on trial
ayahs.e2: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed

ayahs.ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةࣲ وَلَا نَاصِرࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Then man will have no power or any helper
ayahs.e2: Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper
ayahs.tr: Famaa lahoo min quwwatinw wa laa naasir

ayahs.e2: By the sky with its recurring cycles

ayahs.en: And [by] the earth which cracks open
ayahs.e2: and the earth with its sprouting plants

ayahs.en: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement
ayahs.e2: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word
and is not to be taken lightly

ayahs.en: Indeed, they are planning a plan
But I am planning a plan
So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile
ayahs.e2: So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺. Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while
